title: Resources
content: I just found this sub about 15 minutes ago and I am awestruck! My husband and I have visited the same locations in dreams but I didn't realize that many people are visiting the same locations in dreams! I used the pinned recommendation to visit the top posts and catch up and I'm just stunned by how accurate others' depictions are of places I thought existed only in my head. These images elicit visceral reactions! Does anyone have any resources they recommend for learning more? I would like to go down the rabbit hole, if possible! Thanks in advance and thanks for such an incredible sub!
